html:
In the photo, the LX90 GPS with Meade 40mm 4000-series eyepiece and the dew shield.

Wednesday evening, the first clear evening since I got my telescope, an 8" LX90 GPS. -22 deg celsius... In my driveway. I just had time to look at the Perseus double cluster before the cold got the better of the batteries and the observer.
